## What you expected

<!-- And, if you can, where the documentation says so. A mismatch between the

<!-- The shortest sequence that does it. -->

<!-- `ai-tts --version`, and whether you installed from a release or a

## Log lines, if any

<!-- ~/Library/Logs/ai-tts/ (or wherever your launch agent points). The log

anyway before you do. -->
